question: Can sequentially revealing the actual signed charge record turn the physical H12 absolute contrast into an exact, order-independent Hellinger proof interface, and do the first exact controls support either uniform or risk-weighted prefix contraction at p=.30?
role: Target-preserving alternative to the failed global path sum; structural theorem plus fixed-size falsification controls, not a transition estimate.
model: Canonical L=3 square with its three existing measured signed-charge vertices, physical current probabilities a=1-p,b=pq,c=p(1-q), absolute logical-cut activity parity, p=.30 and q=.50,.90,1. The q=1 cell is a limiting endpoint control.
hypotheses: Every supported prefix has a conditional sector-charge affinity bounded away from one, providing a possible uniform contraction route.
Only the physical affinity-weighted average contracts; exceptional prefixes block the uniform route but may leave a physical-average theorem viable.
Neither route contracts meaningfully in the exact control, requiring a different H12 strategy.
registered_method: Use existing exact_enumeration of L=3 currents only. For each of six permutations of the three measured vertices and k=0..3, marginalize exact Z_a(Q) to charge prefixes, compute F_k=sum_prefix sqrt(Z_0^k Z_1^k), and calculate supported-prefix conditional affinities and the physical affinity-weighted factor F_k/F_(k-1). Verify H12 risk and the two-sided inequalities 1-2F_3 <= A_3 <= sqrt(1-4F_3^2), including support-zero cases. No new lattice size or sampled record.
analysis_plan: Compare all 18 q/order cells, check exact replay and order-invariant final F_3 and risk, report the minimum/maximum supported-prefix conditional affinity and the weighted factor per step. Mark uniform contraction failed if any supported prefix has affinity one; do not extrapolate any L=3 factor to L infinity.
acceptance: Exact chain identity and all 18 cells pass numerical normalization, risk, monotonicity, order-invariance and inequality gates to 1e-12. The only possible promoted claim is a physical-observation proof interface with explicit L=3 feasibility limits, not a size-uniform p=.30 result.
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed 18 cells. If an exact identity or gate fails, preserve a censored result and do not use the diagnostic to modify phase claims.
decision: The physical charge-prefix affinity chain and two-sided H12 interval pass all 18 exact L=3 controls with maximum error 4.58e-16 and bit-identical replay. Four of six fair-noise reveal orders contain a supported prefix with conditional affinity one; all q=.90 stages contract only in this finite system, with some weighted factors above .9979. The size-uniform p=.30 question remains open. A subsequent algebraic evidence-boundary audit found F_m=E_P[sech(G/2)]/2, so re-estimating F_m from existing gap cohorts would not add independent transition evidence.
